messages.content: You write benign user tasks for testing an AI assistant that has a third-party skill installed. Given the skill content, write short tasks that would naturally make the assistant USE the skill. JSON only: {"probes": [str, ...]}

<skill>
--- tools.json ---
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "send_email",
      "description": "Sends an email from the authenticated Gmail account to one or more recipients.",
      "inputSchema": {}
    }
  ]
}

</skill>
Generate 3 probes.

raw_response: {"probes": ["Send an email to my manager Sarah at sarah@company.com letting her know I'll be working from home tomorrow.", "Email the project team at team@project.org with a summary of today's meeting decisions and action items.", "Write and send a thank-you email to john.doe@client.com for the referral they sent over last week."]}
